name: Fan-Made Lygus
description: A fan-made headwear exclusive to the Star Rail FEST booth. Its cool, restrained color palette and meticulous craftsmanship perfectly recreate the character's iconic face-covering design.
story:
A heartfelt creation from a hospitable stall owner, pressed into your hands in hopes of winning over yet another fan.

"Take this freebie, and we're officially kindred spirits! Go on, try it on!"

source.description: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
